name: SAMDUMAE, 2026
note:
Dragon blood jasper, diamond, 18ct white gold] 𓅂 𓅂 𓅂

This pendant references two multiheaded birds from Korean folklore and Vedic mythology: the Samdumae, a three-headed hawk believed to protect against the calamities of fire, flood, and wind, and the Gandaberunda, a symbol of strength and resilience.
